name: wide
why: 40 options: both the request's criteria map and the response's probability map exceed 32 keys. Without this a runtime whose small maps iterate in term order only up to 32 entries passes by accident and goes arbitrary at 33 (spikes/classifier/reports/99-verdict.md §3). The keys span digit-leading, uppercase, lowercase and non-ASCII so ASCII ordering is exercised at width, and they are declared in reverse order so insertion order cannot be mistaken for sorted order.
